lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Official website presents the current credit platform and Open Cap entry, and links a Q3 2026 investor update dated October 20, 2026. Current official developer documentation lists the Ethereum stcUSD deployment and documents its deposit/redemption and yield-vesting mechanics. No team-disbandment, shutdown, wind-down or deployment-retirement notice was encountered in the reviewed official sources or targeted lifecycle search. This is documentary lifecycle review, not an uptime or contract-runtime attestation.

deploymentEvidence.sourceType: official Ethereum Mainnet Cap Vault deployment table plus exact-address Etherscan proxy report
deploymentEvidence.evidence: The Ethereum Mainnet table names stcUSD at this exact proxy and separately lists cUSD at 0xcCcc62962d17b8914c62D74FfB843d73B2a3cccC. The same hexadecimal address on other documented chains is not admitted. Etherscan labels this address Cap: stcUSD Token and reports ERC1967Proxy with the StakedCap implementation below.
limitations: Exact proxy Sourcify v2 request returned HTTP 404; Etherscan exact-address page supplies the proxy ABI and applicable implementation report. Direct Python explorer fetch returned HTTP 403; the read tool successfully retrieved the address-bound page.
The explorer Similar Match label is retained verbatim, not promoted to exact-match verification. No fresh on-chain storage, bytecode or implementation-persistence check was performed.

abiEvidence.sourceType: exact reported implementation Sourcify ABI and verified source, applied through exact proxy explorer binding
abiEvidence.evidence: Top-level abi is the full ABI returned for exact implementation 0x42c0e0ef7C2F35de073F4d6f9c0e4483429c3D31, not a generic ERC4626 artifact. Verified StakedCap source inherits the exact source-service ERC4626Upgradeable dependency and overrides only accounting hooks/totalAssets/decimals, not the four user methods. proxyAbi is separately copied from the exact proxy Etherscan page and has no function entries. Source-service match labels describe its record, not a new runtime verification.

sourceReviews.review: Reviewed entire implementation: inherited ERC4626 user methods remain enabled; accounting hooks adjust storedTotal; profit locking and permissionless notify are distinct from cooldown; only UUPS authorization invokes checkAccess.

Reviewed deployed dependency bodies for deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem, maximums, previews, conversions and transfer hooks. deposit/redeem round output down; mint/withdraw round input up. Caller/owner share allowance and asset transfers are explicit.
Reviewed external AccessControl checkAccess binding used by upgrade authorization, not by the selected ERC4626 calls.
Reviewed notDelegated proxiableUUID and onlyProxy upgradeToAndCall, which invokes the application authorization hook and upgrades with setup data.
Reviewed deployed interface: notify/profit-lock views and initializer only; no cooldown/unstake/request/claim methods appear.

selectedFunctions.label: Deposit cUSD into Cap stcUSD
warnings: Exact cUSD asset input; requires caller cUSD balance and allowance to the stcUSD proxy. Shares round down and there is no minimum-share output guard.

Calls target the Ethereum stcUSD proxy, not cUSD or the implementation address. Official documentation identifies cUSD (0xcCcc62962d17b8914c62D74FfB843d73B2a3cccC) as the underlying; current stored asset configuration is not independently attested.

UUPS-upgradeable ERC1967Proxy: Etherscan reports implementation 0x42c0e0ef7C2F35de073F4d6f9c0e4483429c3D31. Authorized access-control actors can replace the implementation. No initialization, upgrade, permit or arbitrary execution capability is admitted.

Exchange rates use storedTotal minus linearly vesting lockedProfit, with ERC4626 virtual assets/shares and integer rounding; small deposits or redemptions may return zero output. Profit locking concerns yield vesting, not a user withdrawal cooldown.

No caller-set deadline, minimum-output or maximum-input parameter exists. All selected functions are nonpayable and require zero native value. Amount, receiver, owner, rate, allowances, balances and gas remain caller responsibilities.

Source and explorer snapshots are admission evidence, not a fresh runtime bytecode/storage identity, funding, backing, balances, liquidity, configuration, execution-success or financial-safety guarantee. Exact-function grants, pause scopes and independent execution controls still apply.
